risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-02p; BR-FUND-19 R3, BR-WDR-05). Daily-check execution step: per app, settle.auto.enabled turned off through an injected content port (own transaction, alertCommitted only after commit) when any non-pay- global difference exists (⑧ always account-level, never turns the switch off); then one transaction per (app, invariant, entity) registering a ledger_mismatch recon diff (source R3, period D, ref_type ledger_account / voucher / order, ref_id <invariant>:<entity>, dedupe_key R3:<D>:<invariant>:<entity>) through registerReconDiffOnce and, only on first insert, one withdraw_holds row per involved user through an injected payout port (reason ledger_mismatch, source_ref recon_diff:<id>, created_by system). pay- invariants register only. users / user_risk_state untouched; involved users resolved only from ledger tables and invariant detail. Same-day reruns are idempotent; a failing step rolls back only itself and the run reports DAILY_CHECK_FAILED.
